sections.text_helper: Section 39.4.1 "DCMIPP common configuration" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1827.
sections.section_content:
The DCMIPP common configuration register (DCMIPP_CMCR) enables the selection of the
input interface—either parallel DCMI or serial CSI-2—from which to fetch the input pixels. It
also allows swapping the R/B color components of the incoming pixels and selecting the
pipe used by the frame counter.
[Table 336. DCMIPP_CMCR bit function]
